spells.name: Gleaming Quill
spells.description: Flings a magical feather that deals magic damage. Striking a champion or epic monster enables Rakan to heal his allies.
spells.tooltip:
Rakan flings a magical feather that deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to the first enemy hit.

If the feather hits a champion or epic jungle monster, Rakan restores {{ totalheal }} Health to himself and nearby allies after {{ healdelay }} seconds or when he touches an allied champion.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Grand Entrance
spells.description: Dashes to a location, knocking up nearby enemies on arrival.
spells.tooltip: Rakan dashes, then spirals into the air, <status>Knocking Up</status> for {{ knockupduration }} second and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Battle Dance
spells.description: Flies to an allied champion granting them a shield. Can be re-cast for free for a short duration.
spells.tooltip:
Rakan dashes to an allied champion, granting them {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ duration }} seconds.

Rakan can Recast this Ability once within {{ recastwindow }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: The Quickness
spells.description: Gains Move Speed, charming and dealing magic damage to enemies touched.
spells.tooltip: Rakan gains <speed>{{ initialcastspeed }}% Move Speed</speed> for {{ duration }} seconds. Rakan deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Charms</status> enemies for {{ charmduration }} second(s) the first time he touches them. The first champion touched grants Rakan <speed>{{ touchspeed }}% decaying Move Speed</speed>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Fey Feathers
effects: Innate: Periodically, Rakan grants himself a shield for 30 : 225 (based on level) (+ 95% AP) that lasts until broken. After being out of combat for 5 seconds, any leftover shield will be restored to maximum value.
Rakan's basic attacks and ability hits reduce Fey Feathers' cooldown by 1 second for each enemy champion hit.

Innate - Lover's Leap: If either Rakan or Xayah is channeling Recall, the other may move nearby and channel their own to join alongside them. Both reach base at the time of which the initiator's Recall completes.

variants.name: Gleaming Quill
effects: If the target was an enemy champion or epic monster, a radius is marked around Rakan. After 3 seconds or if an allied champion enters the radius, Rakan heals himself and nearby allied champions for 40 : 210 (based on level) (+ 55% AP).

variants.name: Grand Entrance
effects: Rakan will be knocked down by any immobilizing or polymorphing crowd control during the dash.

variants.name: Battle Dance
effects: Recast: Rakan mimics the first cast's effects.
Rakan will be knocked down by any immobilizing or polymorphing crowd control during the dash.
If Xayah is the target, Battle Dance can be cast from an increased range.

variants.name: The Quickness
effects: Colliding with an enemy champion extends The Quickness' duration by 0.25 seconds, which can occur once per champion. When Rakan collides with his first enemy champion, he gains an additional 75% bonus movement speed that decays after 0.5 seconds by 20% every 0.5 seconds, then by 15% after decaying by 60% over 1.5 seconds.
During The Quickness, Rakan cannot basic attack enemy champions he did not collide with, unless the attack command was inputted before the ability was activated.

changes.title: Q - Gleaming Quill
changes.text: Base Heal : 30-115 (based on level) (+55% AP) ⇒ 40-210 (based on level) (+55% AP)

changes.title: Passive - Fey Feathers
changes.text: Shield Strength : 30-225 (based on level) (+ 85% AP) ⇒ 30-225 (based on level) (+ 95% AP)

changes.title: General
changes.text: R - THE QUICKNESS BUGFIX: Fixed a bug where charmed enemies would still be able to move and cast abilities

changes.title: Passive - Fey Feathers
changes.text: COOLDOWN: 40-16 seconds (levels 1-17) (reduced by 3 every 2 levels, capping at level 17) ⇒ 40-14.5 seconds (levels 1-18) (reduced by 1.5 every level, capping at level 18)

changes.title: W - Grand Entrance
changes.text: DASH SPEED: 2050 (+30% Rakan's movement speed) ⇒ 1400 (+45/+80 with un-upgraded/upgraded boots)

changes.title: W - Grand Entrance
changes.text: EFFECT DELAY: 0.5 seconds after reaching the destination ⇒ 0.35 seconds after reaching the destination

changes.title: W - Grand Entrance
changes.text: OVERALL: Max-range casts hit slightly later than before; short-range casts hit faster

changes.title: R - The Quickness
changes.text: BUGFIX: Fixed a bug that caused The Quickness to sometimes not affect Rakan's basic attack target
